newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOV'T APPROVES ALITA SHARE CAPITAL BOOST.
newsitem.headline: GOV'T APPROVES ALITA SHARE CAPITAL BOOST.

text.p: Lithuania's government has decided to boost the share capital of state-run sparkling wine producer Alita to 73.09 million litas from 48.52 million litas, the government's press office said on Thursday.
The press office said in a statement that 24.57 million shares with a face value of one litas each would be distributed.
Final approval must be made at the shareholders' meeting on Sunday.
The state's stake in the company will remain the same at 83.76 percent after the issue.
